fingerprint_semantics: SHA-256 over u64be(len(fingerprint_profile)) || exact fingerprint-profile UTF-8 bytes || u64be(len(canonical_descriptor)) || the exact minified encoding/json bytes of this map-free ordered descriptor; encode as lowercase hex with the sha256: prefix.
package_closure_semantics: The selected roots and strictly sorted external package closure were resolved prospectively for CGO_ENABLED=0 on linux/amd64, windows/amd64, and js/wasm and were identical for those targets. linked_package_count is scoped to this prospective closure for candidate modules and does not mean the packages are currently linked into Cutly. Module-graph-only requirements have count zero. The production provider must re-resolve and refreeze its actual package and module graphs for its exact toolchain, targets, build tags, and imports before advertising capability.
sbom_semantics: The deterministic SPDX-2.3 source SBOM records the current Cutly test/module graph and candidate-only text-shape production/module graph separately. Package comments mirror closure, reachability, and linked_package_count, while dependency-lock.json is normative. Candidate presence is review evidence, not an assertion that it is currently imported, linked, shipped, or capability-ready.
dependency_semantics: This lock records the complete current Cutly Go module graph as current_test or current_module_graph_only, binds the exact go.mod and go.sum bytes, and freezes the prospective pure-Go shaping package and MVS module graphs without adding them to cutly/go.mod or a production binary. candidate_production and candidate_production_transitive contain packages reachable from the selected font/harfbuzz roots; candidate_test_generate and candidate_module_graph_transitive are module-graph-only with no selected packages. Module sums and origins were resolved through the Go module proxy. Any current dependency change must explicitly refreeze both module-file hashes and this descriptor. A production provider must re-audit the actually imported package graph and may not silently upgrade any version, sum, commit, build tag, or embedded HarfBuzz base.
build_binding_semantics: cutly_go_directive is the go directive in this source module, not evidence of the toolchain that built a binary. The dependency fingerprint is platform-independent and covers this complete canonical descriptor. It deliberately does not claim an actual Go toolchain, GOOS, GOARCH, build tags, or executable digest. A production provider receipt must combine this fingerprint with host-owned source, exact toolchain and target/build evidence; documents, Agents and render requests may not supply or override it.
license_semantics: Cutly preserves MIT for the current jsonschema-go test import and BSD-3-Clause for its go-cmp module-graph-only upstream test requirement, selects BSD-3-Clause for the dual-licensed go-text modules, preserves BSD-3-Clause plus the upstream PATENTS grant for golang.org/x/image and golang.org/x/text, and preserves the separate MIT notice for the embedded HarfBuzz port. Primary and supplemental notice paths and exact checked-in upstream byte hashes are part of this lock.
capability_semantics: This T1b0 record is supply-chain evidence only. It cannot advertise cutly.text.pinned-font-viewport-px.v2 or prove font parsing, cmap validation, GSUB/GPOS execution, RTL traversal canonicalization, outline extraction, layout, rasterization, cancellation, or live document/font binding.
excluded_responsibilities: Downloading modules at runtime, resolving floating tags, trusting system fonts, accepting a caller-provided fingerprint, executing shaping, parsing hostile fonts, emitting a text surface, signing receipts, and enabling any backend capability are outside this candidate lock.
